notes.title: Q1 celebration illustration!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37294989/1922be1bae361e99f0f051c49c390d9673adf6ff.png[/img]

Developer GENSHI sent us an illustration and a message to celebrate three months since the release of this title!

"Manor of Mystic Courtesans♥" has been released just Q1 (3 months) ago.
I'm very grateful for It has been purchased by much more people than I could imagine. 

To cerebrate of Q1 passage, and 40K followers on my Twitter, I drew an illustration of Maria and Freya's duo.
Actually, this might be the first time I've ever illustrated a two-shot of these two?
I hope you can feel their relationship from the illustration."

notes.title: "Manor of Mystic Courtesans" is now available for purchase!!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37294989/f2701adf31215bee15a52d0de563767d06bea5b4.png[/img]
We got a greeting message from main illustrator / game developer of this visual novel, GENSHI.
[i]Hello everyone, and thank you for your patience!

At long last, "Manor of Mystic Courtesans" is now available for purchase on steam!!
It gives me great joy to finally bring the most wild and sexual visual novel game in all Steam history out for the world  to see!
not only is this game full of cute and beautiful characters, but you get to see them in the most hardcore situations you could possibly imagine!
What kind of situations you ask? Well, download it on steam to see for yourself and find out!!

Includes 4 supported languages: Japanese, English, Simplified and Traditional Chinese
each translated and localized with great care for your enjoymen[/i]t!
